plan.tagline: A minimalist Python CLI to track invoices and chase overdue payments for freelancers.
plan.problem: Freelancers and small businesses often lose valuable time manually tracking invoice due dates and sending follow-up reminders, leading to delayed payments and cash flow issues.
plan.solution: Invoice Chaser provides a simple command-line interface to add invoices, mark them as paid, list overdue invoices, and generate templated follow-up messages, ensuring timely payment reminders without complex software.
plan.target_market: Independent contractors, freelance developers, designers, writers, and small service-based businesses worldwide who prefer command-line tools and need an efficient, no-frills solution for invoice management.
mvp_features: Add new invoices (client, amount, due date)
Generate templated follow-up message for a specific invoice

build_phases.name: Core DB + add/list
build_phases.description: Initialize sqlite3 DB, implement 'add' and 'list' commands for invoices.

build_phases.name: Payment + Reports
build_phases.description: Add 'mark-paid' command, implement overdue invoice reporting and follow-up message generation.

build_phases.name: Demo + Polish
build_phases.description: Implement '--demo' mode with sample data, add comprehensive '--help' and basic error handling.

plan.demo_script: Run `invoice-chaser --demo`. It will populate a temporary DB with sample invoices, list all invoices, then list overdue invoices, and finally show a generated follow-up message for one overdue invoice.
plan.phuket_angle: Freelancers and digital nomads in Phuket, often serving international clients, can use this tool to efficiently manage their cash flow without relying on cloud services or complex accounting software, fitting the lean, independent lifestyle common in the region. It helps them stay on top of payments from clients across different time zones.
